neighbours.label: the word just before a 'fits / perfect for' judgement: things that suit or fit something
fire: This small table fits neatly into the corner of the kitchen.
The blue scarf fits perfectly with her winter coat.
His quiet style fits the role of the lonely detective.
The new key fits the old lock exactly.
A short walk after dinner fits easily into a busy day.
The song fits the mood of the final scene perfectly.
This bookshelf fits right between the two windows.
The plan fits well with the city's long-term goals.
quiet: This small table stands in the corner of the kitchen.
The blue scarf hangs next to her winter coat.
His quiet style annoyed the director of the film.
The new key opened the old lock after a while.
A short walk after dinner is common in our town.
The song played during the final scene of the film.
This bookshelf was built from old pine boards.
The plan was presented to the city council on Monday.

notes: Logit effect promotes exactly/perfect/perfectly/fits. Card peaks: ' absolutely' perfect for, ' fits' in well, ' is' great for. Probe was weak: ' fits' 0.23, ' exactly' 0.18, ' absolutely' 0.02-0.04. Likely to fail.
